assertions: Dumpster cannot be installed on Archives and redirects the run to Archives, starting an encounter with the outermost rezzed Archives ICE or normalizing to the post-ICE jack-out window when Archives has no rezzed ICE.
Entrapment and Vortex open a Corp target choice when the two-credit Deflector cost can be paid, spend the credits on resolution, and redirect the run to the selected data fort.
Trapdoor can only be installed on HQ or R&D, redirects to a subsidiary data fort, and auto-breaks its Deflector subroutine when no subsidiary data fort target exists.
Glacier can only be installed inside a subsidiary data fort, costs one public Corp agenda point in addition to normal rez cost, and has two End-the-run subroutines.

Glacier may move to the outermost position of another data fort at the start of a run for one credit, revealing itself if unrezzed and updating the currently approached ICE when it moves to or from the attacked fort.
